name: Gallerie dell'Accademia
notes: The Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice, in the old Scuola Grande and convent of Santa Maria della Carità on the Grand Canal: on the Campo della Carità the Gothic brick front of the church with its gable, pointed portal and rose window beside the Scuola's classical front in white Istrian stone (after Giorgio Massari's design) with pilasters and pediment; behind, rendered ranges under tile roofs round Palladio's cloister and a second court; the Grand Canal and the wooden Accademia bridge arching over it from the campo. On the bearing of the canal front from the OpenStreetMap ground, rasterised in rows. Heights, the courts' sizes and the fronts' proportions are guessed from general knowledge. No photographs were available.
